devdoc.details: Upgrades are expected to happen infrequently (every few months).      Performing an upgrade while another upgrade is still within its active rollback window is not an expected scenario and is not supported.      The design assumes the rollback period will have elapsed before any new upgrade is performed.

params.implementation_: The rollback implementation whose storage should be cleaned up.

params.rollbackImplementation_: The currently active implementation to rollback to.

params.newImplementation_: The new, recently upgraded currently active implementation being replaced by the old one in the rollback.
